title: Phase 4 review sub-loop structurally blocked on newly-created spec files
description: The Per-Step Review Sub-Loop in Phase 4 of spec.skill.md attempts to modify the spec file via patch_file (or write_file per the new spec) after it was created in Phase 4. However, read-set enforcement rejects any modification to a file that was not read before being modified. Since spec files are created (not read) in Phase 4, the review sub-loop always fails to apply its improvements. StepMetric for spec-file in this run: iteration_count=1, acceptance_rate=0.0. This is a structural gap that prevents every spec session's Phase 4 review loop from functioning.
proposed_resolution: Add an explicit read_file call for the spec file path immediately after the write_file in Phase 4, before the review sub-loop begins. This adds the newly-created file to the read set without semantic overhead. Alternatively, update the kernel read-set enforcement to consider write_file on a new file as implicitly adding it to the read set.
